reason: The body says it outright — 'All five are in SafeSpace code from this branch, so none can have been hit from a stable tag' — but the Beta-only trailer was never added, and beta is never force-pushed. Without this the subject reaches an upgrader as 'SafeSpace edges a pre-PR review found by driving them', reviewer shorthand for a bug they never had, in one of twelve Fixed slots.

The Beta-only trailer is wrong. v1.17.1 ships both halves of this bug: automation-engine.ts reads `const verdict = result.ok ? "dispatched" : "blocked (action-failed)"` and defaults `simulate: true`, so a 1.17.1 install in its default configuration logged 'dispatched' while nothing reached a device. The trailer deletes a real fix from the notes.
